text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 104,289 to 94,724 overall, so simply holding has not protected its value; I should review whether each position still fits my goals.","The declines and brief recoveries were uneven and hard to predict, so I should not treat recent price moves as reliable signals for the next month.","I made no trades, but inaction is also a choice; I should set clear reasons to hold, buy, or sell and review them periodically without anchoring on my purchase price."]}
